text:
Mike (Sales): heads-up — FinNova wants a POC to replace CompetitorX with Redwood. They currently call a swagger-style facade and expect identical responses. timeline: 3 weeks. primary asks: drop-in API, same auth, same error codes, identical output for downstream ingest 
Anya (Solutions Eng): ok. do we have their swagger + sample payloads? can we map streaming vs non-streaming? :thinking: 
Mike (Sales): sent the spec to my email, attaching minimal example below. they use API-Key header and a webhook callback for async jobs. 
Liam (SRE): curious about auth — are they ok switching to our API key format or do they require header-presence parity? also need list of IPs for allowlist. 
Mike (Sales): they asked for header parity (x-api-key) and exact 401/403 behaviour. IP allowlist acceptable, will confirm. 
Sarah (Solutions Eng): quick note — CompetitorX returns a top-level "request_id" and sometimes inserts a "meta.trace" object. We'll need a small mapping shim to preserve keys so downstream doesn't break. 
Anya (Solutions Eng): proposed shim prototype (we can run in Redwood Proxy layer):
```json
// incoming CompetitorX request -> Redwood generation
{
  "method": "POST",
  "path": "/v1/predict",
  "headers": {"x-api-key": "..."},
  "body": {"prompt": "...", "params":{}}
}
// Redwood response remap -> CompetitorX shape
{
  "request_id": "<redwood_request_id>",
  "output": {"text": "..."},
  "meta": {"model": "redwood-v1", "latency_ms": 123}
}
```
Anya (Solutions Eng): important: preserve token billing headers so finance/usage tracking stays identical. 
Karen (PM): timeline check — if shim work is done in-proxy, can we deliver a smokeable POC in 10 business days? FinNova wants end-to-end happy-path and error parity. 
Liam (SRE): 10 days looks tight but doable if we scope to non-streaming endpoints and 1 model profile. need a small infra ticket for ephemeral staging pool and allowlist. ops-bot: created infra ticket INF-4821 for staging pool. 
Mike (Sales): FinNova will test with ~200 req/s peak. can we hit that on a single small staging pool? 
Liam (SRE): runbook: start with 4x A10g equiv for staging, enable autoscale to 8, apply rate-limiting rules to mimic their burst. I'll add latency benching. 
Sarah (Solutions Eng): question on streaming: competitor sometimes chunked SSE responses. we should return a non-streamed full payload for POC unless they insist. streaming parity is a separate spike. 
Mike (Sales): they insisted on identical error payloads for client-side retry logic. can we add per-route error mapping? 
Anya (Solutions Eng): yes, we can add an error map for common cases (429 -> same error code body, 5xx -> pass-through with CompetitorX-shaped body). small regex-based mapper. 
Karen (PM): security questionnaire items: they want SOC2 section filled and confirmation on KMS use + if we store request bodies. sec-bot: linked questionnaire -> https://redwood.internal/sec/questionnaires/finnova-competitorx.json :lock: 
sec-bot: flagged items: data retention, KMS key policy, private deployment option. 
Mike (Sales): legal also needs an estimate of cost delta vs CompetitorX. they care about token billing parity and request-level pricing. can solutions eng provide a rough delta? 
Anya (Solutions Eng): initial guess: for same model capacity, our per-token is ~0.9x competitor for generation but tokens/response shape might change. will run token-delta on 50 sample prompts. 
Sarah (Solutions Eng): I'll prepare a small test harness and run 50 payloads ASAP. results in this thread. 
Liam (SRE): blockers: IP allowlist confirmation, KMS scope for POC (we can use staging key but note enterprise wants customer-managed KMS for production). 
Mike (Sales): FinNova security rep prefers customer KMS for production, but ok with staging key for POC. 
Anya (Solutions Eng): action items: 1) get their swagger + 50 sample payloads (Mike) 2) infra ticket (INF-4821) created (Liam) 3) prototype shim in proxy with error mapping (Anya/Sarah) 4) security Q tracked (sec-bot) 5) timeline: aim for smoke POC in 10 business days (Karen) 
Karen (PM): I'll coordinate weekly check-ins with FinNova and send a short status deck after first smoke. 
Mike (Sales): thanks team. anything else? :thumbsup: 
Sarah (Solutions Eng): one more: if they require identical timestamps in response, we can inject a "server_time" field but note it will differ slightly; flag as potential acceptance test. 
Mike (Sales): noted. I'll escalate acceptance criteria. 
Anya (Solutions Eng): starting work on mapper tonight, will post short diffs here. 
ops-bot: deployed ephemeral staging pool INF-4821 -> staging-redwood-finnova, creds posted in vault.
